consequence.statement: Existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten. A storage version migration must rewrite all objects and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: Rewrite all PolicyException objects so they are stored as v2. Then remove v2beta1 from status.storedVersions on the policyexceptions.kyverno.io CRD.

assertion.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0, the storage version of the policyexceptions.kyverno.io CRD changes from v2beta1 to v2. Existing PolicyException objects stay stored as v2beta1 until they are rewritten, so operators must run a storage version migration and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v2beta1.
